properties.name: loop_status answered 10,605 characters when asked for budget_chars 3000 (the breach list is kept whole)
properties.statement:
Observed 2026-10-26 by the trial-triage agent on reflow2's design through flo2.io (reflow2 0.92.0): loop_status with budget_chars 3000 answered 10,605 characters; the reply kept the whole breach list. Observation only: the cause is not established (whether `breaches` is exempt from the budget by design, or the budget is not applied to it). Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018ibUbMKCS1yK5W17cncp9P

ROOT CAUSE ESTABLISHED (root-cause skill, measured) 2026-10-26. ① OBSERVED again, locally: main's committed design copy (02e2739c8) imported into a scratch store and asked through the 0.92.0 release binary, `loop_status {budget_chars: 3000}` answered 11,767 characters (compact JSON); the budget block said applied:true, full_chars 39,890, fields_trimmed 104 at prose_limit 0, and "THE LIST ITSELF IS NOT shortened AND THE REPLY IS STILL 10904 CHARACTERS". NOT affected: the owner-scoped call, whose `awaiting_word` gives rows. ② PRECEDENT: chg of 2026-10-14 (the scoped answer's `awaiting_word` bound, tests/a_scoped_loop_status_fits_its_budget.rs); flo2.io timed out on loop_status at 30 s today, so the hosted reply was not re-read. ③ CANDIDATES: (a) the bound lets only `awaiting_word` give rows, so every other list is kept whole; (b) OUTSIDE reflow2: flo2's door did not pass budget_chars; (c) a floor clamps small budgets; (d) the observation measured the door's wrapper (view_note, the persona block), not the engine's reply. ④–⑤ MEASURED: (b) refuted: the local --call with no door applied the 3000 budget (budget.budget_chars 3000). (c) refuted: no clamp in reply_budget.rs. (d) refuted: the engine's own reply is 11,767 with no wrapper. (a) holds, in source: coherence.rs ends loop_status with bound_reply_list_first(payload, budget, "awaiting_word", ...); with `awaiting_word` empty (every unscoped call) it returns bound_reply(full, ...), the prose-only rung whose rule is "for this tool completeness IS the answer", so 104 texts were cut to nothing (each of `next`'s 26 to-do lines became "…") and all 20 breach rows stayed (4,880 characters with their names cut; 12,633 whole). ⑥ CLASS: a bound that names ONE list as allowed to shorten, written for the reply's biggest list on the day (awaiting_word, 2026-10-14), while the reply holds a dozen lists that grow with the design (breaches, cross_design_links, the attention lists, the reasoning id lists), each already counted beside it. FIX (PR fix/the-impact-path-reads-whole-and-names-only-served-tools): bound_reply_list_first gives the named list's prose, then ROWS from every list but `next` (costliest first, from the tail, floor one row, each counted in budget.lists_shortened), and only then prose elsewhere; the block's note no longer repeats the list. Pinned by a_scoped_loop_status_fits_its_budget.rs::an_unscoped_loop_status_withholds_breach_rows_before_prose_and_counts_them, observed FAILING on main (7,100 chars to a 6,000 budget, breaches whole) and passing after. Re-measured on the same scratch store with the fix: budget 10,000 → 9,754; 6,000 → 5,249; 3,000 → 5,449, which is the reply's floor (every count, one row per list, `next`'s lines, all prose cut) and the reply says so. ⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: whether 3,000 should be reachable at all (it needs lists emptied below one row, or counts dropped, which the budget rule forbids; a decision for the owner); the hosted reply's exact size (flo2.io timed out); this scratch store's `next` is larger than the hosted one's because the files it reports missing are not under its root. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018ibUbMKCS1yK5W17cncp9P
